window: R15 (3–4 Dec): 4 trades, locked at Thursday 3 Dec 19:30 Athens (Efes–Valencia). FIBA window until 1 Dec; official R15 prices are out.
bottom_line: Out of Zvezda, into Olympiacos v ASVEL: Koloko → Perrin, Navarro → Bartzokas (OLY), Nwora → Grigonis, Marinkovic → Fournier, captain Vezenkov. Robinson stays: at the official prices he's cheaper than yesterday and Perrin covers Kamenjas' knee doubt. About 28% for 200 (7% as you stand), 0.3 left.
current_fix: With no trades: captain Vezenkov (Friday, home to ASVEL) instead of Robinson (at Madrid), Ward as the Friday sub. About 145 expected, a 7% chance of 200.

variations.name: Perrin, Bartzokas, Grigonis, Fournier

Koloko: 6 PIR in 12' with Moneke and Motley back, DNP in the ABA, and Zvezda are 31% in Istanbul. [dom: ACB 22 Nov for Lleida at A Coruña, stat line unverified after 2 searches (season 17 val avg), acb.com]
Olympiacos are 94% at home to ASVEL (site margin +18): the +20/+25 brackets are in play. Navarro (RED) is 31% away after a 24-point home loss.

Zvezda 31% at Fenerbahçe and Nwora is an afterthought in Navarro's offence. Grigonis: 26 PIR at Madrid, a bigger role with Lo, Sirvydis and Williams-Goss out, home to Dubai on Friday. [dom: LKL 22 Nov at Lietkabelis (123–94 win), unverified after 2 searches, lkl.lt]

Marinkovic: 4.4 PIR a game and absent in the ABA on 22 Nov. Fournier: 27 PIR (23 pts, 11 ast) v Hapoel in 32' as Olympiacos' lead creator with Montero out. Risk: Dorsey, who is fit but has 'no timeline' from Bartzokas. [dom: GBL 22 Nov 20' 15 pts, PIR 11, esake.gr]

variations.captain_note: Vezenkov: 26.3 PIR over his last three and 27 pts for Bulgaria on 26 Nov, home to the league's 19th defence with Fournier, Ward and Bartzokas in the same game. Best captain in R13 and R14.
variations.captain_plan: Captain Vezenkov from the start; Thursday's starters are there to be swapped, not to carry the armband.
reasoning: About 28% for 200 and 178 expected (7% as you stand): the optimiser's best plan, and it is balanced over both nights.

Nights: Thursday Robinson, Carter, Kamenjas, Perrin, Maledon, Frisch; Friday Vezenkov, Ward, Grigonis, Fournier. After Thursday: Carter under ~16 → Fournier; Perrin under ~12 → Ward; Robinson under ~11 → Grigonis.
Coach lens: Baskonia's frontcourt is Kamenjas and Perrin with Faried and Santos out; owning both means you get the minutes whoever is healthier.
Team 2 has no per-game rule, so this stacks three Olympiacos players plus Bartzokas: the biggest single-game risk on either team, and the biggest ceiling.
Upside watch: Grigonis and Perrin taken; Cory Joseph would be a fourth Olympiacos player.
cancel_if: If Kamenjas is ruled out, keep the plan: Perrin starts in his place and Frisch moves up to the starting five.
If Dorsey is confirmed back in Olympiacos' rotation, swap trade 4 to Marinkovic → Andres Feliz (10.1) (bank 0.6): that is C.
If Robinson is ruled out, sub Ward into the Thursday slot and keep the trades.

alerts.text: No round has started since yesterday, so nothing new was applied to teams/team2/team.json (inbox empty; 24 Nov Variation A stays). R15 trades lock Thursday 3 Dec 19:30 Athens.

Change from yesterday: A now keeps Robinson and sells Koloko and Marinkovic instead. Official R15 prices (Robinson 12.7, Fournier 10.4, Grigonis 8.0, Bartzokas 10.6) and Kamenjas' new doubt make Perrin the first buy.
Kamenjas was left out of Bosnia's game in Iceland (26 Nov) with the knee knock from R14. With Perrin bought, a Kamenjas absence costs you a bench player, not a starter.
Team 2 has no per-game rule, so A stacks three Olympiacos players plus Bartzokas: the biggest single-game risk on either team.
Dorsey is fit (35' for Greece) but Bartzokas gives 'no timeline'; I trimmed Fournier to 14.0 for the chance he plays. Vezenkov had 27 pts for Bulgaria on 26 Nov.

rumours.text: Shaquielle McKissic will stay at Türk Telekom despite Olympiacos' interest (26 Nov).
rumours.impact: No new wing for Olympiacos: Ward keeps Konchar's minutes. Bartzokas (OLY) stays the R15 coach pick.

rumours.text: Bartzokas on Dorsey: 'There is no timeline. I'm here for players who give everything.' Dorsey served his suspension but hasn't played since Round 6; he played 35' for Greece on 26 Nov.
rumours.impact: If he's back, he takes guard minutes from Fournier and Cory Joseph; Vezenkov and Ward are unaffected.

rumours.text: Kamenjas missed Bosnia's qualifier in Iceland with the knee knock from R14; Perrin (11 pts, 12 reb, 20 PIR in 24') is the new starting-calibre big.
rumours.impact: Kamenjas' minutes ceiling ~25'; Perrin is the hedge (Team 2 buys him).

rumours.text: Wenyen Gabriel has torn his ACL (25 Nov); Nowell is still out after nose surgery.
rumours.impact: Even more of Besiktas' offence runs through Lonnie Walker; Alimpijevic (BES) is not a coach pick.

rumours.text: Campazzo (hamstring) is using the FIBA break to finish his recovery; the player targets the 3 Dec Clásico, the club won't rush him.
rumours.impact: If he plays, Maledon's minutes drop a little and Procida's may vanish; Tavares unaffected.

rumours.text: Mitoglou left Greece's loss to Georgia in overtime with a left-leg (hamstring area) injury.
rumours.impact: More frontcourt minutes for Hayes-Davis; Obradovic (PAN) at Besiktas is a 63% coin flip either way.

rumours.text: Justin Anderson is leaving Dubai for PAOK.
rumours.impact: Small: a few more wing minutes for Musa and Bacon at Zalgiris.

review: R14 (scorecard, unchanged since yesterday): Variation A scored 54.8 against 176 predicted; captain Robinson 5 against best Vezenkov 23, and Zvezda (Carter 0, Koloko 6, Navarro −20) did the rest. Lessons kept: the default captain is the Olympiacos home star, and no coach on a team in a slump. No new round to score today (FIBA window). Since yesterday: official R15 prices replaced the estimates, Kamenjas became a doubt, and Perrin moved to the top of the buy list; I changed Robinson → Fournier to Marinkovic → Fournier because the money now works and Perrin covers the Kamenjas risk. Research (shared with the main team): 29 searches, 9 pages read, 4 players unverified (Perrin's last Lleida game, Grigonis, Ward, Marinkovic's stats).
